integrity: The proof uses exact event probabilities, an exhaustive finite tree enumeration with a completeness argument, and an analytic all-order inequality. The accompanying checker is reproducible but not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Global variance minimizers are identified through eleven vertices only; for all larger orders, the result establishes strictly better double-star competitors to stars rather than optimality.
Edges are retained independently at the fixed probability one half, not arbitrary retention bias.
Finite minimizers are certified by a reproducible isomorphism-complete enumerator; independent external audit is absent.
Full text of a relevant 2020 cluster-size-moment paper was not accessible; historical priority remains qualified.
title: The eleven-vertex reversal in isolated-cluster variance under bond percolation on trees
